## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests updated where relevant
- [ ] Typecheck and build checked
- [ ] Keyboard and screen reader considerations reviewed
- [ ] Compatibility / bundle-size implications noted
- [ ] Docs updated for API changes
- [ ] Exports, registry and Changeset updated when public packages change
- [ ] Shared AI guidance reviewed when structure, commands or update workflows change
